# spectral.freq_list { #maxwellbloch.spectral.freq_list }

```python
spectral.freq_list(mb_solve)
```

Fourier transform of the tlist into the frequency domain for
    spectral analysis.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type    | Description                                 | Default    |
|----------|---------|---------------------------------------------|------------|
| mb_solve | MBSolve | An MBSolve object.                          | _required_ |
| Returns  |         | Array[num_time_points] of frequency values. | _required_ |
